purpose: Verify saved frozen SourceBridge results and quantify paired variability without changing methods, attacks, targets, budgets or thresholds.
public_comparisons: SourceBridge proper MLNI minus every saved interface; primary presentation includes all four published papers, both FETD cores, equally enhanced proper MLNI and median/midpoint controls.

statistics.public_cluster: Date: all stations, attacks and methods stay together. Circular moving-block bootstrap over all 28 dates with block lengths 1, 3, 7; 7-day is main sensitivity. Not a confirmatory test or familywise claim.
statistics.public_estimand: Difference in aggregate RMSE from event-level clean squared errors or event-level maximum squared error over the frozen 14-element library.
statistics.procurement_cluster: Seed: all six pools, two budgets and four precision requests stay together. Report seed-mean conditional fractional savings and per-radius conditional request-weighted savings, with percentile intervals; infeasible requests remain explicit and excluded only from conditional cost statistics.
statistics.prohibited: No test of the tautological optimal-objective noninferiority; no selection of favorable block length or comparator.

replay: First and last valid event in lexicographic event order, both profiles and every frozen attack (64 cases). Recompute all 13 nominal/midpoint interfaces, two compositions, exact packet certificates, using only saved purchased input and frozen parameters. Compare to saved outputs; do not load evaluator truth during prediction.
source_policy: Original project is read-only; disable Python bytecode, write all outputs under current work/experiments.
